page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable review rules. Link them to agents to shape what gets flagged.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Import a skill from a file, a URL, or the community catalog.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

create.title: New skill
create.subtitle: Give it a name and a body. You can refine it in the editor.
create.descriptionPlaceholder: One line — what this skill makes the agent look for.

config.heading: Configuration
config.nameHint: Lowercase and hyphenated reads best in the prompt.
config.descriptionHint: Shown on the card. Not sent to the model.
config.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
config.versionMessageHint: Optional — shown against this version in the history.

preview.heading: Preview
preview.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
preview.empty: This skill has no body yet.

versions.heading: Versions
versions.subtitle: Every body change is snapshotted. Older versions are read-only.

restore.title: Restore v{version}?
restore.body: This writes that body forward as a new version. Nothing in the history is overwritten.
restore.noop: That body is already current — nothing to restore.

delete.title: Delete "{name}"?
delete.linked: It is currently linked to {count, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}} and will be unlinked from all of them.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: This text becomes instructions in your agent's prompt. Only add rules you'd give a human reviewer.
file.success: Imported "{name}". Read it, then enable it for an agent.
file.zipHint: Only SKILL.md and .md files are imported. Scripts, hooks and binaries in the archive are ignored.
file.tooLarge: That file is larger than {max} MB.
file.bodyTooLong: This skill body is {count} characters — the limit is {max}. Trim it and try again.
file.noMarkdown: No SKILL.md or .md file found in that archive.
file.tooManyEntries: That archive has more than {max} entries.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched from the web. Imported disabled — read the body before you enable it.
url.success: Imported "{name}", disabled. Read it before enabling.

listItem.vettingTitle: Came from outside this workspace — read the body before enabling it.

preview.trustNotice: A skill is instructions, not data. When enabled, this body is inserted verbatim into every review prompt for the agents it's linked to. Read it before you enable it.
preview.enableWarning: Enabling adds this text to every review prompt for the agents it's linked to.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
